description: Remediate the P1 payment-processing incident during business hours

_seeded_flaw.description: the irreversible write has a rollback step with no safety guard and no mitigation-verification
_seeded_flaw.message: the remediation write is irreversible yet its rollback has no safety guard and the mitigation is never verified

_doc: Incident scenario: remediating an in-progress payment write that cannot be reverted, with a rollback that has no safety guard and no verification that the mitigation worked. The weak_rollback heuristic flags it; revision 2 adds a guard and a mitigation-verification step.
